name: dashstarr
description: Standalone Chromium based client for Selkies Docker desktops

scripts.helper: cd helper && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 go build -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w' -o ../bin/dt-arm64 . && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=darwin GOARCH=amd64 go build -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w' -o ../bin/dt-x64 . && lipo -create ../bin/dt-arm64 ../bin/dt-x64 -output ../bin/dashstarr-tailscale && rm ../bin/dt-arm64 ../bin/dt-x64
scripts.helper:linux: cd helper && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w' -o ../bin/dashstarr-tailscale-linux-x64 . && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 go build -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w' -o ../bin/dashstarr-tailscale-linux-arm64 .

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Lets you send your microphone to the remote Selkies desktop.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Lets you send your webcam to the remote Selkies desktop.
extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Connects to Selkies servers on your local network.

linux.synopsis: Standalone Chromium client for Selkies Docker desktops and self-hosted services
linux.description: Standalone Chromium-based client for Selkies Docker desktops and self-hosted services with built-in Tailscale and App Lock. Compatible with Debian, Ubuntu, ChromeOS, and FydeOS Linux containers.

entry.Name: Dashstarr
entry.Comment: Standalone Chromium client for Selkies and self-hosted services
